newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Mobile targets 8 pct sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Korea Mobile targets 8 pct sales rise.

text.p: Korea Mobile Telecom Co, South Korea's largest celullar phone operator, has set a 2.7 trillion won target for this year's sales, up eight percent from 1996, a company statement said on Friday.
The company plans to invest 1.75 trillion won in facility modernisation and expansion and 201.6 billion in research and development projects, the statement said.
The statement gave no comparable figures for 1996.

The company expects its celullar phone subscribers to increase to 4.3 million this year from 2.89 million in 1996 and radio paging subscribers to 6.8 million this year from 6.57 million in 1996, the statement added.
